en: Colorized vintage street scene titled "Diekirch – L'Esplanade." It shows a broad tree-lined esplanade or avenue with neatly trimmed trees on both sides, flanked by low-rise European townhouses and shops. A group of children stand in the middle of the road in old-fashioned clothing, while a few adults walk further down the street. On the left is a building with a sign reading "CAFÉ DE L'ESPLANADE." The style and coloration suggest an early 20th‑century postcard.
